mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals active monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth >100k and UNRATE decline >0.2pp signal a strong labor market that drives corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing market activity (HOUST > 1600k units) indicates robust consumer spending, which consistently precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST > 1600k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand and economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods of rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous INDPRO decline >3.0% and GDPC1 growth <1.0% signal economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO falls >3% and GDPC1 growth <1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) during FEDFUNDS > 5.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
